name: Bluegrass Solar Farm
notable: 257 MW solar farm near Chinchilla, QLD. Developed by X-ELIO with Stanwell Corporation as offtaker. Located in Queensland's Western Downs energy corridor.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

timeline.title: COD estimate updated
timeline.detail: COD changed from 2023-06 to 2023-06-30 (source: AEMO Generation Information)

eis_specs.document_title: Blue Grass Solar Farm – Material Change of Use consent (Western Downs Regional Council); Powerlink Blue Grass Solar Farm Connection Project
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: New Cameby 132 kV substation (Powerlink), tie-in to the existing Chinchilla–Columboola 132 kV transmission line
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: New Cameby substation constructed by Powerlink to link the facility to the existing 132 kV Chinchilla–Columboola line (energised 2022)
eis_specs.notes: Developer X-Elio (Brookfield-owned since 2022). 200 MWdc / ~148 MWac; near Chinchilla in the Western Downs. J.A. Martin EPC. Financial close Jan 2022 (CEFC A$37M). 10-yr Salesforce virtual PPA + 49 MW Stanwell offtake. Grid connection and commercial operation Nov 2022. 148 MW grid-forming BESS being added 2025–26.
